metadata.description: Hemant Soren, Chief Minister of Jharkhand, faces corruption allegations and arrest by a central agency. In his defence, Soren asserts his Adivasi identity, alleging targeting by the BJP. This strategic move aims to rally tribal support but risks polarization. The impact on forthcoming elections remains uncertain.
